label: does this earlier line help?
instructions: Does the earlier line or memory in quoted_candidate help {name} reply to the message in quoted_query?
true: Yes: it holds a fact, name, detail or event the reply needs or should take into account.
false: No: it is about something else, or only shares words with the message.
state_note: memory D33: one request per candidate (≤ 6), read by retrieval.agent.recall.checkMs; keep ≤ 3 at or above t_recall, by p. Every answer missing: the top 2 of the merged order, unscored.
